title: Work cost of the junta learner
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $k$, and an accuracy parameter $\varepsilon$ with $0 \le \varepsilon \le 1/2$, the work cost of the low-degree junta learning algorithm is at most $4$ times the number of calls in a depth-$k$ junta tree times the node work linear coefficient at $k$, multiplied by $(n+1)^{\lfloor 3k/4\rfloor+4}$.
